post.text: NZ Parliament @NZParliament May 16, 2019 Happy #IDAHOBIT, Int'l Day Against Homophobia, Biphobia, Intersexism & Transphobia - 29 years since @WHO took homosexuality off its list of diseases. It's also @pinkshirtdaynz! The perfect day to Kōrero Mai, Kōrero Atu, Mauri Tū, Mauri Ora #speakup #standtogether #stopbullying
